name: Project health
description: Whether the work is moving, how far along each project is, and who is carrying what.
long_description:
The dashboard to open before a check-in. The top row answers the three questions somebody always asks — how much is open, how much is late, how much got finished lately — and says how far along the whole thing is.

Underneath, each project's finished and remaining work sits side by side, so a project that has stopped moving is visible next to one that has not. Beside them, each person's open work is split by project, so somebody spread across many shows as many colours. The board deals every open task into a column per person, each card led by its project, which is the fastest way to see who is carrying what and where it came from.

Nothing here needs setting up — every widget reads the initiative the dashboard lives on. Read-only, like every dashboard: it shows the work, and the work is changed where it lives.
release_notes: Open work by person is split by project, showing who is spread across which projects.

binding.sql: SELECT count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(*) AS overdue FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND due_date < now() AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at >= now() - CAST('30 days' AS interval) AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(tasks.completed_at) AS finished, count(*) AS total FROM tasks WHERE tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false

SELECT p.name AS project, count(t.completed_at) AS finished, count(*) - count(t.completed_at) AS remaining FROM projects p JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = p.id WHERE p.archived_at IS NULL AND p.is_template = false AND t.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name

SELECT assignee.display_name AS person, project.name AS project, count(*) AS open FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false GROUP BY assignee.display_name, project.name ORDER BY assignee.display_name, project.name

widgets.title: Open work by person and project

binding.sql: SELECT concat(project.name, ' · ', title) AS card, assignee.display_name AS person, due_date FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false ORDER BY project.name, due_date

SELECT p.name AS project, count(*) - count(t.completed_at) AS open, count(*) AS total FROM projects p JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = p.id WHERE p.archived_at IS NULL AND p.is_template = false AND t.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY count(*) - count(t.completed_at) DESC
